title: Equivariant principal bundles over toric Deligne--Mumford stacks
summary: Let $\mathscr{X}(\boldsymbolΣ)$ be the toric Deligne--Mumford stack with stacky torus $\mathscr{T}$ associated to the stacky fan $\boldsymbolΣ = (N,Σ, β)$. A toric principal $H$-bundle over $\mathscr{X}(\boldsymbolΣ)$ is a principal $H$-bundle $\mathscr{P}$ equipped with a $\mathscr{T}$-action lifting the $\mathscr{T}$-action on $\mathscr{X}(\boldsymbolΣ)$, such that the $\mathscr{T}$-action and the $H$-action on $\mathscr{P}$ commute.
